30-year old here. You seem to have similar taste, I really enjoyed all of the anime you listed. I'll list a few of my favorites that you didn't list off the top of my head:

Another: A good horror anime that keeps you guessing.  

Baccano: Set in prohibition America. Very cool story, much more than meets the eye.  

Gunslinger Girl: A drama about a secretive Italian government agency that turns dying children into assassins. Is not as dopey as it sounds like it could be. Pretty serious plot.  

Kaiji: You've probably seen it, but if you haven't: Cleverly written story about a life or death gambling game  

Monster: Again, you've probably seen it, but just in case... About a world famous surgeon turned fugitive.

And just a few fun ones, in case you missed them: Nichijou was a rather funny slice of life show, as is Doki Doki School Hours. Sadly neither are as good as Azumanga Daioh, but I really enjoyed them regardless.  

Slayers is the show that got me into anime. Very fun classic comedy / fantasy show from the 90's.
